title: Oversized Document Rejected
description: A 6MB customs scan slips right past the picker's accept filter — file size isn't even checked client-side. Prove the server's 5MB cap (FR-705) still holds, and the UI reports the rejection honestly instead of pretending it worked.
successCondition: Uploading a well-formed PDF file exceeding 5MB (5 * 1024 * 1024 bytes) through the Confirm step's document uploader results in a visible Alert with an error message, the document list gaining no new entry, and a follow-up GET /api/booking/:id/documents confirming the oversized file was never persisted server-side — the rejection is a genuine 400, not a client-side guess.
hints: Generate a file just over the boundary (e.g. 5MB + 1 byte) to specifically exercise the edge, in addition to a comfortably oversized one.
The list only reflects documents actually added to component state on a successful upload response — a failed upload should never call setDocuments.
